priorities.name: An Affordable City
priorities.definition: Make Ottawa more affordable for residents by managing costs responsibly, delivering value for tax dollars, and improving access to services that reduce cost of living.

priorities.name: A City with a Thriving, Diversified Economy
priorities.definition: Foster economic growth, attract investment, support local business, and prepare the workforce for a changing economy.

priorities.name: A City that has More Affordable Housing & Reduced Homelessness
priorities.definition: Expand the supply of affordable, attainable housing and reduce chronic homelessness through coordinated city-wide action.

priorities.name: A Green & Resilient City
priorities.definition: Advance climate action, environmental stewardship, and infrastructure resilience to protect Ottawa's environment and prepare for climate impacts.

priorities.name: A Connected, Walkable, Mobile City
priorities.definition: Improve mobility through reliable transit, safe streets, active transportation, and a road network that supports residents and goods movement.

priorities.name: A City Built on Equity & Inclusion
priorities.definition: Embed equity, diversity, inclusion, and anti-racism into how the City designs, delivers, and measures services for all residents.

priorities.name: Service Excellence & Modernization
priorities.definition: Modernize how the City works — digital service delivery, data-informed decisioning, efficient operations, and an empowered workforce — to deliver excellent services to residents.
